title: IFRS 9 Financial Transaction Price
columns:
Transaction Price
Paragraph 5.1.3 of IFRS 9 has been amended to replace the reference
to ‘transaction price as defined by IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts
with Customers’ with ‘the amount determined by applying IFRS 15’. The
use of the term ‘transaction price’ in relation to IFRS 15 was potentially
confusing and so it has been removed. The term was also deleted from
Appendix A of IFRS 9.
An entity applies the amendments for annual reporting periods beginning
on or after 1 January 2026. Earlier application is permitted.
